facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition's policy letter in the World Bank appraisal says the National Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2035 (NDTS 2035), developed with co-financing from the Bank's RAPID programme to make digital a catalyst for the Ivorian economy's structural transformation, was presented at a workshop on 6-7 May 2025 and validated at a workshop on 19-22 August 2025; the document records no adopting act.

The policy letter states NDTS 2035 implementation rests on financing estimated at CFAF 4,452 billion, of which the Government of Côte d'Ivoire is to provide 28 percent; it names no budget line (letter in the World Bank appraisal of 18 September 2025, date of the letter not given).

The same financing estimate gives technical and financial partners 43 percent of the CFAF 4,452 billion and the private sector, through public-private partnerships, 29 percent; the Bank's RAPID programme co-financed the strategy's preparation (appraisal of 18 September 2025).
